channel.desc: Get ready for the best bits of an epic year on Blue Peter! We look back at some of our favourite moments ? from Joel saddling up as a rancher in Canada and Abby discovering real dinosaur footprints on the Isle of Skye, to Shini encountering tigers in the wild in India and brand new presenter Hacker T Dog officially joining the show.
